exposure: Serum pregnancy associated plasma protein A (PAPP-A) levels
Doppler ultrasound combined with serum pregnancy associated plasma protein A (PAPP-A)
cohort: 250 pregnant women who underwent cesarean section delivery at a single hospital between February 2020 and February 2021.
finding: Doppler ultrasound combined with serum PAPP-A levels showed good sensitivity and specificity for diagnosing placenta accreta, suggesting their potential clinical value.
